Assistant (0.0s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. Am I speaking with Mr Reyes?

User (1.2s): Yes, this is Daniel Reyes speaking.

Assistant (1.2s): Thank you. Could you please provide your date of birth?

User (2.5s): My date of birth is 14 March 1988.

Assistant (3.0s): Thank you. Now, please provide the last four digits of your phone number.

User (5.0s): The last four digits are 44

Assistant (5.1s): I'm sorry, I need the last four digits of your phone number. Could you please provide all four?

User (7.3s): The last four digits are 4471.

Assistant (7.7s): Thank you, that's verified. I'm calling about your Freya Bank account, do you have a minute?

User (8.7s): Yes, I have a minute.

Assistant (9.0s): You have a past due amount of dollars420 on your credit card. When can you pay this?

User (10.6s): I can pay the full amount today.

Assistant (10.7s): To confirm, you will pay dollars420 today, October 14th, 2026. Is that correct?

User (12.5s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (13.2s): Thank you, your payment promise has been recorded. Have a good day.
